t: The Magic Rolling Pin: An Experiment in Agentic Code Refactoring
s: This article explores agentic code refactoring using Gemini CLI on NixOS, contrasting Nix's declarative system management with traditional methods. It details the author's 'Rule of 7' refactoring goal and showcases a human-AI 'vibe coding' workflow.
sub: Agentic AI code refactoring using Gemini CLI
NixOS package management for bleeding-edge tools
